correctness.rationale: On the smooth GL₂ frame bundle the section is the rank-two open part of the cycle binomial edge variety. Radicality descends; the rank-one prime disappears, and each surviving prime has n frame parameters (one direction per run plus n−|T| column scalars). This gives pure dimension n−4 and hence regular-sequence codimension n, making adjunction and the degree calculation valid. A pair of adjacent zero columns gives a zero Jacobian row. Otherwise a nonzero proportional run of length r supplies r−1 independent rows, by taking the transverse coordinates successively from an endpoint. Each isolated zero gives a disjoint two-coordinate block whose rank is the rank of its neighbors. Thus the total rank is n−2|Z| plus the sum of these block ranks, and smoothness descends through the frame bundle in every characteristic. In the p₃₅ chart the specified germ eliminates every constraint except st=0, with n−5 free ratios. At n=5 the five nonadjacent pairs yield five coordinate lines meeting in a cycle; at n=6 the six distance-two pairs, three opposite pairs and two alternating triples give respectively linear planes, Segre quadrics and linear planes. Fresh RREF enumeration of F₂ in sizes 4–7 and F₃ in sizes 4–6 agreed at all 282 finite-field solution points (95 full-rank).
residual_risks: Fresh computation checks only the tangent criterion in bounded fields and sizes; the geometry and unrestricted hypotheses are justified by the proof.
The crossing calculation applies only to the specified stratum; the nonreduced singular subscheme is not classified.

originality.rationale: Credit radicality and component indexing to the established cycle binomial-edge decomposition and the numerical consequences of a complete intersection to standard geometry. The supported distinct claim is the full cyclic pointwise rank-two smoothness test and its specified crossing chart. The strongest archive overlap uses path rather than cyclic edges. Its argument is closely related, but the deleted endpoint equation is absent from that theorem and changes the local rank problem. The exact graph literature checked addresses component ideals, not smoothness of all points of this rank-two quotient of their union.
residual_risks: The close structural analogy with the path record is real; their displayed dates do not determine priority.
The bounded comparisons do not exclude unlocated equivalent cycle formulations or antecedents for the illustrative small sections.

value.rationale: The all-point criterion turns singular-support determination for a natural family of reducible Grassmannian sections into tests on zero columns and pairs of directions. It distinguishes smooth rank-two configurations from component intersections, gives a usable crossing chart, and applies in small characteristic without relying on finite lists. These geometric uses are distinct from counting known components.
residual_risks: No claim about the scheme structure of the singular locus or general singular germs is supported.
